# EuroCIM 2027 Paris, France


The conference will be from 14-16 April 2027, with pre-conference tutorials on the 13th.

More information coming soon!



## Key dates

| Event | Date |
|------------------------|--------------------|
| Pre-conference courses | 13 April 2027 |
| EuroCIM Paris | 14-16 April 2027 |


## Venue

Campus Saint-Germain</br>
Université Paris Cité</br>
45 rue des Saints-Pères</br>
75270 Paris cedex 06</br>
France

[Get directions on Google maps](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ps5xyJARwKoJh4gu7)
